ReSound Hearing Aids
Roberts Hearing Clinic is an authorized provider of ReSound hearing aids in Alexandria, LA.
ReSound creates smart hearing aids to help you hear better in your daily life. Whether you’re talking with family, working, or enjoying social time, ReSound hearing aids make listening easier.
With today’s advanced technology, ReSound is always improving its hearing aids to bring you clear and natural sound.
Together with ReSound, our goal is to help you hear more, do more, and enjoy life to the fullest .
Current ReSound Hearing Aid Models at Roberts Hearing Clinic
Here are the latest ReSound hearing aids available at Roberts Hearing Clinic .
ReSound Enzo IA

The ReSound Enzo IA is designed for severe to profound hearing loss. It is the world’s smallest rechargeable Super Power hearing aid and the first of its kind to support Bluetooth LE Audio and Auracast broadcast streaming.
With a stylish, durable design, the ReSound Enzo IA is built for the most challenging listening situations. It offers exceptional clarity, feedback control, and all-day battery life.
Unique Perks and Features:
Clear Focus: Automatically reduces background noise while highlighting speech.
360 All-Around listening: Naturally shifts attention between voices and surrounding sounds.
Comfortable and weatherproof: Lightweight, all-day wear with protective nanocoating.
Flexible connectivity: Supports Bluetooth® LE Audio, Auracast™, and direct streaming from multiple devices.
ReSound Vivia

ReSound Vivia™ is a smart hearing aid that helps you hear clearly in any setting. It uses special technology that works with your brain to make hearing feel more natural. Whether you’re in a noisy place or a quiet room, ReSound Vivia helps you focus on the sounds that matter.
Why You’ll Love It:
All-Day Power: Lasts all day, even when streaming calls or music.
Weatherproof: Protected against water and dust.
Bluetooth & Auracast™: Connects easily to phones, TVs, and more.
Auracast Assistant: Lets you hear public broadcasts at places like theaters and airports.
ReSound Savi
ReSound Savi™ is a comfortable and easy-to-use hearing aid that helps you stay connected all day. It offers clear sound, a lightweight design , and easy Bluetooth® connections.
All-Day Power: Works all day, even with streaming.
Weatherproof: Resistant to water and dust.
Bluetooth & Auracast™: Connects to your phone, TV, and other devices.
Auracast Assistant: Helps you hear important announcements in public places.
Hands-Free Calls: Answer calls with a tap, no need to hold your phone!
ReSound Nexia

ReSound Nexia uses Organic Hearing™ to give you clear, natural sound . You can stream calls and music from iPhones, iPads, and some Android devices directly to your hearing aids. It even works as a headset for Mac computers, making online meetings and video calls easier.
For people with hearing loss in one ear, ReSound Nexia offers a CROS system , which sends sound from the weaker ear to the stronger ear, helping you hear clearly from both sides.
Bluetooth Connectivity : Uses the latest Bluetooth for the best sound and battery life.
Auracast Broadcast Audio : Lets you stream public broadcasts straight to your hearing aids.
App & Remote Help: Adjust settings and manage tinnitus with the ReSound Smart 3D app.
ReSound Omnia RIE & Mini RIE

ReSound Omnia hearing aids are designed for natural sound and comfort . They come in two styles: RIE (Receiver-in-Ear) and Mini RIE . These hearing aids work for mild to severe hearing loss and offer rechargeable or battery-powered options.
Bluetooth Connectivity: Works with iPhones, iPads, and Android devices for hands-free calls.
Fitting Assistance: The Check My Fit tool helps you wear them correctly.
App & Remote Help: Adjust settings, fine-tune sound, and manage tinnitus from your phone.
Tinnitus Relief: The ReSound Relief app offers sound therapy and relaxation exercises.
ReSound Omnia ITE

ReSound Omnia also comes in In-The-Ear (ITE) styles, designed to fit comfortably inside your ear. These hearing aids are custom-made for your ears , making them more secure and reducing wind noise. ReSound Omnia ITE models come in different sizes to match your needs:
In-the-Canal (ITC)
Completely-in-the-Canal (CIC)
Invisible-in-the-Canal (IIC)
These hearing aids work for mild to profound hearing loss and come in rechargeable or battery-powered options.
Bluetooth Connectivity: Pairs with iPhones, iPads, and Android devices.
Fitting Assistance: Check My Fit ensures the best placement.
App & Remote Help: Adjust sound settings and manage tinnitus from your phone.
Tinnitus Relief: The ReSound Relief app provides relaxation and sound therapy.
ReSound Omnia BTE & Power BTE

The Behind-the-Ear (BTE) style is another option in the Omnia family. These hearing aids are designed for people with severe to profound hearing loss . They make speech 150% clearer in noisy places, so you can follow conversations more easily.
These hearing aids work for mild to profound hearing loss and come with rechargeable batteries.
Fitting Assistance: Check My Fit ensures they are placed correctly.
App & Remote Help: Adjust settings and fine-tune your hearing aids from your phone.
Assistive Listening Devices & Technology by ReSound
ReSound also offers extra devices to make hearing even easier:
TV Streamer 2 – Sends TV sound directly to your hearing aids.
Phone Clip – Helps with hands-free phone calls.
Multi Mic – Makes it easier to hear in noisy places or meetings.
Remote Control – This lets you adjust your hearing aids easily.
Older ReSound Hearing Aid Models Supported by Roberts Hearing Clinic
If you have an older ReSound model, Roberts Hearing Clinic may still be able to service and repair it. Contact us to learn more. Older models we support:
ReSound Key
ReSound One
ReSound Picasso
ReSound Enzo Q
ReSound LiNX Quattro
ReSound LiNX 3D
ReSound Enzo 2
ReSound LiNX 2

Rexton Hearing Aids
Roberts Hearing Clinic is an authorized provider of Rexton Hearing Aids in Alexandria, LA.

Rexton is known for delivering durable, high-quality hearing aids with cutting-edge features. Designed to meet the real-world needs of individuals with hearing loss, Rexton devices are built to provide clear sound, reliable performance, and ease of use even in busy environments.
With powerful processors and user-friendly designs, Rexton makes hearing care simple and effective.
Current Rexton Hearing Aid Models in Alexandria, LA
These are the Rexton hearing aid models available at Roberts Hearing Clinic .
Rexton BiCore R-Li and R-Li T (Receiver-in-Canal Models)
The Rexton BiCore R-Li and R-Li T are slim, rechargeable receiver-in-canal (RIC) hearing aids. They deliver clear sound, enhanced speech understanding, and better comfort-even in noisy settings.
Key Features:
BiCore Processing Platform – Fast sound processing and natural listening experience
Rechargeable Battery – Full-day power and quick charging
Motion Sensor Technology – Adjusts settings based on your movements
Bluetooth® Streaming – Connects directly to smartphones and devices
IP68 Rating – Water and dust resistant for active lifestyles
Tinnitus Therapy Options – Soothing sound features for tinnitus relief
Rexton BiCore Custom Li (In-the-Ear Rechargeable Hearing Aid)
The Custom Li is a discreet, custom-fit ITE model with all the latest technology in a compact design. It’s made to match your ear shape and lifestyle.
Custom Molded Fit – Comfortable and secure
Rechargeability – No disposable batteries needed
Bluetooth® Compatibility – Direct streaming from iPhones and Android devices
Simple Tap Control – Easy volume and program changes
Tinnitus Sound Therapy – Custom relief tones for managing tinnitus
Rexton BiCore BTE Models (M, P, HP)
For those needing more power, BiCore BTE hearing aids offer strength and clarity in a comfortable design. These models come in three levels of power: Mild (M), Power (P), and High Power (HP) .
Clear Speech Focus – Better understanding in noise
Flexible Power Options – Rechargeable or traditional batteries
Telecoil Compatibility – Useful in churches, theaters, and more
App Support – Adjust settings with the Rexton App on your smartphone
Rexton CROS/BiCROS Solutions
For patients with single-sided hearing loss , Rexton CROS and BiCROS systems send sound from the unaidable ear to the better-hearing ear-giving you a more complete listening experience.
Seamless Audio Transfer – Hear from all directions
Bluetooth Streaming – Listen to calls, music, and media
Compatible with Rexton BiCore RIC and BTE models
Rexton Accessories and Support Tools
Enhance your experience with these helpful Rexton accessories :
Smart Transmitter 2.4 – TV audio streaming directly to your hearing aids
Smart Mic – Personal microphone and Bluetooth streamer
Smart Key Remote – Small, simple remote control
Charging Stations – Easy overnight or portable charging options
Rexton App – Change programs, adjust volume, and track battery life
Older Rexton Models Still Supported at Roberts Hearing Clinic
We continue to provide service and support for select older Rexton models, including:
Rexton Emerald Series
Rexton Stellar Li
Rexton Mosaic BTE
Rexton inoX ITE
Contact us to find out if your current hearing aids can be adjusted or repaired.
Frequently Asked Questions About Rexton Hearing Aids
How long do Rexton hearing aids last?
Most Rexton hearing aids last around 5 to 7 years , depending on usage and care. Our audiologists can help you decide when it’s time to upgrade.
Are Rexton hearing aids rechargeable?
Yes. Many models, like BiCore R-Li and Custom Li , are rechargeable and provide all-day power with simple charging.
Can I stream calls or music to my Rexton hearing aids?
Absolutely. Many Rexton models offer direct Bluetooth streaming from iPhones and compatible Android devices.
Do Rexton hearing aids have tinnitus relief features?
Yes. Several models include tinnitus therapy tones designed to ease ringing or buzzing in your ears.
How do I control my Rexton hearing aids?
You can use the Rexton App , a remote control, or your hearing care provider can adjust your devices in person or remotely.
Rexton Hearing Aids in Alexandria, LA
If you’re interested in learning more about Rexton hearing aids , schedule a hearing consultation at Roberts Hearing Clinic today.
Our Alexandria, LA audiologists are ready to help you choose the best hearing solution for your lifestyle, hearing loss, and personal preferences.

You can use the Rexton App, a remote control, or your hearing care provider can adjust your devices in person or remotely.

Sensorineural Hearing Loss Treatment in Alexandria, LA
Roberts Hearing Clinic provides sensorineural hearing loss treatment in Alexandria, LA.

Sensorineural hearing loss (SNHL) happens when the inner ear or the nerve that sends sound signals to the brain is damaged. This type of hearing loss makes it hard to hear soft sounds and can make louder sounds unclear or distorted . SNHL is usually permanent because the tiny hair cells in the inner ear do not grow back once they are damaged.
Why Seeking Treatment Is Important

If left untreated, SNHL can make it harder to understand conversations, enjoy daily activities, and stay connected with family and friends . It can also lead to social isolation, frustration, and even memory problems over time. The good news is that with the right treatment, you can improve your hearing and quality of life .
Symptoms of Sensorineural Hearing Loss
SNHL can develop gradually or suddenly. Some common signs include:
Difficulty hearing soft or whispered sounds
Trouble understanding speech – People may sound like they are mumbling.
Frequently asking others to repeat themselves
Struggling to hear in noisy environments like restaurants or group settings
Ringing in the ears (tinnitus)
Hearing better in one ear than the other
Feeling like sounds are muffled or far away
Difficulty hearing high-pitched sounds like children’s voices or birds
If you experience any of these symptoms, it’s important to schedule a hearing test with an audiologist . Early diagnosis can help you get the best treatment for your hearing needs.
Causes of Sensorineural Hearing Loss
SNHL can be caused by different factors, including:
Aging (Presbycusis) – Over time, the tiny hair cells in the inner ear wear down and stop working properly.
Loud Noise Exposure – Repeated exposure to loud sounds (concerts, power tools, firearms) can damage the inner ear.
Genetics – Some people are born with SNHL or have a family history of hearing loss.
Certain Medications – Some drugs, known as ototoxic medications , can damage the inner ear and cause hearing loss.
Head Injuries – A strong blow to the head can harm the inner ear or the hearing nerve.
Illnesses and Infections – Viruses, fevers, and autoimmune diseases can sometimes cause permanent hearing loss.
Knowing the cause of your SNHL can help your audiologist recommend the most effective treatment for your specific needs.
Sensorineural Hearing Loss Diagnosis and Treatment

At Roberts Hearing Clinic , diagnosing SNHL starts with a hearing test performed by an audiologist . This test measures how well you hear different sounds and speech. If hearing loss is found, we will discuss the best treatment options to help you hear better.
Treatment Options for SNHL

Hearing Aids – These small devices amplify sound , making speech and other noises clearer. Modern hearing aids have advanced technology , including noise reduction, Bluetooth connectivity, and rechargeable batteries.

Cochlear Implants – For people with severe hearing loss who do not benefit from hearing aids, a cochlear implant may be recommended. This device bypasses the damaged inner ear and directly stimulates the hearing nerve.
Bone-Anchored Hearing Aids (BAHA) – This type of device is attached to the bone behind the ear and helps those with single-sided deafness or mixed hearing loss.
Your audiologist will help determine the best treatment based on your level of hearing loss and lifestyle needs .
What Is the Best Treatment for Sensorineural Hearing Loss?
The best treatment depends on how much hearing loss you have:
Mild to moderate SNHL – Hearing aids are often the best solution.
Severe SNHL – If hearing aids are not enough, cochlear implants may be recommended.
Single-sided deafness or mixed hearing loss – A bone-anchored hearing aid (BAHA) may be the best option.
Your audiologist will work with you to find the best hearing solution for your needs.
Can You Fix Sensorineural Hearing Loss?

Currently, there is no cure for SNHL because the tiny hair cells in the inner ear do not grow back once they are damaged. However, treatments like hearing aids and cochlear implants can help restore hearing ability and improve daily communication . The sooner you seek treatment, the better your brain can adapt to hearing devices.
How Do You Prevent Further Sensorineural Hearing Loss?
While SNHL cannot always be prevented , there are steps you can take to protect your hearing:
Avoid loud noises – Use ear protection when around loud sounds like concerts, power tools, or gunfire.
Turn down the volume – Keep your music and TV at a safe listening level .
Take listening breaks – If you use headphones, give your ears a break every hour.
Check your medications – Some drugs can cause hearing loss. Ask your doctor if your medications are safe for your ears.
Get regular hearing check-ups – Early detection can help slow hearing loss and improve treatment options.
Protecting your hearing now can help you enjoy better hearing in the future .
Sensorineural Hearing Loss Treatment in Alexandria, LA
At Roberts Hearing Clinic, we understand how important hearing is to your daily life. Our team of experienced audiologists is here to help with:
Comprehensive hearing tests to diagnose SNHL
Customized treatment plans tailored to your needs
Advanced hearing aids, cochlear implants, and other solutions
Compassionate care focused on your hearing health
If you or a loved one is struggling with hearing loss, don’t wait. Early treatment can make a significant difference in your hearing and quality of life.
Call us today to schedule an appointment!

Hearing Aid Services in Alexandria, LA
Roberts Hearing Clinic provides expert hearing aid services in Alexandria, LA.

If you or a loved one is experiencing hearing loss, finding the right hearing aid is an important step toward better communication and overall well-being. At Roberts Hearing Clinic, we provide expert care to help you select and adjust hearing aids that match your needs.

Our services include hearing tests, hearing aid selection, custom fittings, adjustments, and repairs. We are dedicated to improving your hearing and quality of life through professional and compassionate care.
Benefits of Expert Hearing Aid Services
Improved Communication – Helps you hear conversations more clearly in different environments.
Enhanced Quality of Life – Enjoy sounds, music, and social interactions with ease.
Better Cognitive Function – Reduces the risk of memory problems linked to untreated hearing loss.
Reduced Social Isolation – Stay connected with family, friends, and community.
Hearing Aid Selection

Choosing the right hearing aid depends on your type of hearing loss, lifestyle, and budget. Our audiology team guides you through the process, explaining the different styles, features, and benefits of each option. We take the time to understand your hearing needs and recommend the best device for you.
Starts with Hearing Assessments
The first step to better hearing is a professional hearing test. This helps determine the level and type of hearing loss. Common tests include:
Pure-Tone Audiometry – Measures how well you hear different tones.
Speech Audiometry – Tests how well you understand words in quiet and noisy settings.
Tympanometry – Checks the health of your eardrum and middle ear.
Hearing Aid Styles
Hearing aids come in different styles, each designed for different needs:
Completely-in-the-Canal (CIC) – Small and nearly invisible, best for mild to moderate hearing loss. Pros: Discreet. Cons: Shorter battery life, can be difficult to handle.
In-the-Canal (ITC) – Slightly larger, sits partly in the ear canal. Pros: More features than CIC. Cons: Still small, may be hard to adjust.
In-the-Ear (ITE) – Fits in the outer ear, easier to handle. Pros: Larger battery, easier controls. Cons: More visible than ITC or CIC.
Behind-the-Ear (BTE) – Rests behind the ear with a tube leading to an earpiece. Pros: Suitable for all levels of hearing loss, easy to adjust. Cons: More noticeable.
Hearing Aid Fitting

Once you select a hearing aid, our audiologists ensure a comfortable and secure fit. We take ear impressions and customize the device for your ear shape and hearing needs. A proper fit ensures clear sound and prevents discomfort.
Hearing Aid Programming and Adjustments

Your hearing needs may change over time, requiring adjustments. Our audiologists fine-tune your hearing aid settings for comfort, clarity, and background noise reduction. Adjustments may be needed due to changes in hearing, feedback issues, or new environments.
Counseling and Education
Understanding how to use and care for your hearing aids is key to success. We provide guidance on:
Communication strategies
Proper device care
Managing hearing loss in daily life
Our audiologists ensure you feel confident using your hearing aids.
Real Ear Measurements

A real ear measurement test ensures your hearing aids are delivering the right level of amplification for your ears. This involves placing a small microphone in your ear to check sound levels while you wear your hearing aids.
Why is Real Ear Measurement Important?
This test confirms your hearing aids are set correctly for your specific hearing needs. It helps improve speech clarity and ensures you receive the best possible hearing experience.
Hearing Aid Repairs
Hearing aids may need repairs due to wear and tear. At Roberts Hearing Clinic, we offer:
Repairs for most hearing aid brands
Troubleshooting for minor issues
Cleaning and maintenance services
We also repair hearing aids not purchased from our clinic. For major repairs, we may need to send the device to the manufacturer.
Follow-up and Maintenance
Proper care helps your hearing aids last longer. Some tips include:
Keep them dry and clean
Store them in a protective case
Change batteries regularly or charge them as needed
Schedule regular check-ups with our clinic
Roberts Hearing Clinic Hearing Aid Services
At Roberts Hearing Clinic, we are committed to helping you hear your best. From selecting the right hearing aid to ongoing care and adjustments, we provide expert support every step of the way.
Contact us today to schedule a consultation with expert audiologists in Alexandria, LA!

Hearing aids come in different styles, each designed for different needs:

  • Completely-in-the-Canal (CIC) – Small and nearly invisible, best for mild to moderate hearing loss. Pros: Discreet. Cons: Shorter battery life, can be difficult to handle.
  • In-the-Canal (ITC) – Slightly larger, sits partly in the ear canal. Pros: More features than CIC. Cons: Still small, may be hard to adjust.
  • In-the-Ear (ITE) – Fits in the outer ear, easier to handle. Pros: Larger battery, easier controls. Cons: More visible than ITC or CIC.
  • Behind-the-Ear (BTE) – Rests behind the ear with a tube leading to an earpiece. Pros: Suitable for all levels of hearing loss, easy to adjust. Cons: More noticeable.

Hearing Aid Fitting

Once you select a hearing aid, our audiologists ensure a comfortable and secure fit. We take ear impressions and customize the device for your ear shape and hearing needs. A proper fit ensures clear sound and prevents discomfort.

Hearing Aid Programming and Adjustments

Your hearing needs may change over time, requiring adjustments. Our audiologists fine-tune your hearing aid settings for comfort, clarity, and background noise reduction. Adjustments may be needed due to changes in hearing, feedback issues, or new environments.

Counseling and Education

Understanding how to use and care for your hearing aids is key to success. We provide guidance on:

  • Communication strategies
  • Proper device care
  • Managing hearing loss in daily life

 

Our audiologists ensure you feel confident using your hearing aids.

Real Ear Measurements

A real ear measurement test ensures your hearing aids are delivering the right level of amplification for your ears. This involves placing a small microphone in your ear to check sound levels while you wear your hearing aids.

Why is Real Ear Measurement Important?

This test confirms your hearing aids are set correctly for your specific hearing needs. It helps improve speech clarity and ensures you receive the best possible hearing experience.

Hearing Aid Repairs

Hearing aids may need repairs due to wear and tear. At Roberts Hearing Clinic, we offer:

  • Repairs for most hearing aid brands
  • Troubleshooting for minor issues
  • Cleaning and maintenance services

 

We also repair hearing aids not purchased from our clinic. For major repairs, we may need to send the device to the manufacturer.

Follow-up and Maintenance

Proper care helps your hearing aids last longer. Some tips include:

  • Keep them dry and clean
  • Store them in a protective case
  • Change batteries regularly or charge them as needed
  • Schedule regular check-ups with our clinic

Roberts Hearing Clinic Hearing Aid Services

At Roberts Hearing Clinic, we are committed to helping you hear your best. From selecting the right hearing aid to ongoing care and adjustments, we provide expert support every step of the way.

Contact us today to schedule a consultation with expert audiologists in Alexandria, LA!

Signia Hearing Aids
Roberts Hearing Clinic is an authorized provider of Signia hearing aids in Alexandria, LA.

Signia supports the idea of “Hear Well and Be Well.” Their hearing aids use smart technology to help people hear better and feel better in everyday life. One of their latest advancements, called Augmented Xperience (AX), helps people hear speech more clearly-even when background noise is loud.
With a wide variety of styles and features, Signia offers a hearing aid option for just about everyone.
Current Signia Hearing Aid Models In Alexandria, LA
Styletto IX
The Styletto IX hearing aid has a slim, stylish look and powerful features. It’s perfect for people who want a modern design with excellent hearing support.
Key features of the Styletto IX:
Helps you hear voices clearly, even in noisy places.
Uses AI (artificial intelligence) to automatically adjust based on where you are.
Unique Features:
Rechargeable: The small charging case provides power for up to three days on one charge.
Bluetooth Connectivity: You can stream music, phone calls, and other audio straight from your smartphone or tablet.
RealTime Conversation Enhancement: The hearing aid responds to your surroundings to help you follow conversations better.
Pure Charge&Go IX
The Pure Charge&Go IX blends high-quality sound with easy everyday use. It’s one of Signia’s most popular rechargeable models.
Key features of the Pure Charge&Go IX:
Great speech clarity, even in busy or loud areas.
AI-powered technology personalizes sound to match your environment.
Bluetooth Connectivity: Connects to phones, TVs, and more for wireless listening.
Rechargeable: One full charge gives long-lasting power throughout the day.
Comfortable Design: Lightweight and made for all-day comfort.
Silk Charge&Go IX
This small hearing aid is made for comfort and ease. It fits right out of the box-no custom mold needed.
Instant Fit Design: Soft silicone Click Sleeves offer a snug and comfortable fit right away.
Clear Sound Quality: Reduces background noise and focuses on voices.
Bluetooth Streaming: Easily connect to smartphones and stream calls or music directly.
Insio IX IIC/CIC
These hearing aids are tiny and custom-made to fit deep in your ears. The IIC (Invisible-in-Canal) and CIC (Completely-in-Canal) models are designed to be discreet but still powerful.
Custom Fit: Each device is made to fit your ear for secure and comfortable wear.
Low-Profile Design: Hard to see when worn, perfect for people who want a discreet look.
Remote Control Capability: You can control settings using the Signia app on your phone.
Signia Pure Charge&Go T AX
This model uses special Augmented Focus™ technology to keep speech and background noise separate. This makes speech easier to understand in all types of environments.

Good for mild to severe hearing loss, this RITE (receiver-in-the-ear) style is rechargeable and provides up to 36 hours of listening time per charge. The Pure 312 AX offers similar features but uses a small disposable battery.
Bluetooth Connectivity: Stream directly from iPhone or Android smartphones.
App: Use one simple app for settings, adjustments, and support.
Remote Help: Get help anytime using the 24/7 Signia Assistant and TeleCare services.
Signia Styletto AX
The Styletto AX offers many of the same benefits as the Pure AX, but in a slimmer and more stylish shape. It’s a great option for people who wear glasses or prefer a sleek design.
This rechargeable device gives up to 20 hours of use per charge. The small charging case uses wireless charging, so you don’t need a plug-just place it on a charging pad.
Bluetooth Connectivity: Enjoy wireless streaming from your phone or other devices.
App: Control your hearing aid and get help from the same app.
Remote Help: Easy access to support through the Signia app anytime.
Signia Insio Charge&Go AX

These are custom-made rechargeable hearing aids that fit comfortably in your ear. Signia was the first to offer custom hearing aids with contactless charging-just place them in the charger, no wires needed.
They are good for mild to severe hearing loss and can run up to 24 hours on a single charge.
Bluetooth Connectivity: Listen to calls, music, and videos from your phone or tablet.
App: One app for managing settings and getting support.
Remote Help: Get help and support between visits using the app.
Signia Motion X
This behind-the-ear (BTE) hearing aid is strong, reliable, and very long-lasting. It offers up to 61 hours of power on one charge and is a great option for people who want extra performance.
It works for mild to profound hearing loss and still feels comfortable all day.
Bluetooth: Connects easily to phones, computers, and other devices.
App / Remote Help: Make changes and get help through the Signia app.
Tinnitus Relief: Includes therapy sounds that may help manage ringing in the ears.
Signia CROS AX
CROS AX helps people who have hearing loss in only one ear. It sends sound from the weaker ear to the stronger ear, so you don’t miss what’s going on around you.
CROS styles include:
CROS Styletto AX: Slim design, 20 hours use per charge.
CROS Pure Charge&Go AX: Rechargeable model with up to 29 hours of use.
CROS Pure 312: Uses a 312 battery, up to 4 days of battery life.
CROS Silk X: Tiny size, instant fit, and ready to wear.
Bluetooth Connectivity: Stream music and calls from Apple and Android devices.
App: Control hearing aid settings, access support tools, and even track health activity through the Signia app.
Assistive Listening Devices & Technology by Signia
StreamLine TV – Sends sound from your TV directly to your hearing aids.
StreamLine Mic – Works as a microphone or hands-free call device.
StreamLine Remote – Easy remote control for volume and program changes.

Starkey Hearing Aids
Roberts Hearing Clinic is an authorized provider of Starkey hearing aids in Alexandria, LA.

Starkey is known for creating advanced hearing aids that help people hear better in all kinds of situations. Starkey hearing aids are small, custom-fit hearing aids that are comfortable and reliable for various listening situations.
Starkey also uses artificial intelligence (AI) to improve sound quality and make listening easier. Their wide range of hearing aids fits different needs and lifestyles.
Current Starkey Hearing Aid Models
Starkey Omega AI

Starkey Omega AI is built with industry-leading technology that gives users powerful sound clarity and day-long comfort. Its advanced AI system constantly analyzes your surroundings to help you hear speech clearly, stay aware of important sounds, and move through different environments with ease.

If you struggle with hearing in noisy places, Omega AI’s Edge Mode+ provides on-demand help by sharpening speech instantly, even in challenging spaces like restaurants, shopping centers, or family gatherings.

These hearing aids are also designed for durability. With a 10x more durable waterproof coating, Omega AI can handle rain, sweat, and everyday wear without worry. Rechargeable options give all-day power, keeping you connected from morning to night.
Unique Features:
Edge Mode+: Boosts speech clarity during tough listening moments.
Waterproof & Everyday-Proof: Designed for active lifestyles and all-day comfort.
Auracast™ & LE Audio Ready: Allows streaming from TVs, smartphones, public announcement systems, and more.
Starkey App (Now Powered by Gen AI): Use TeleHear AI for instant, AI-based sound adjustments.
Starkey Signature Series

The Starkey Signature Series gives you amazing sound in hearing aids that are super tiny and almost invisible. They are custom-made to fit inside your ear, so no one can tell you’re wearing them. You’ll hear your friends, family, and the world around you clearly, without anyone knowing why. Whether you want rechargeable, adjustable, or the smallest size possible, there’s a signature style just for you.
Discreet: Nearly invisible and fits deep in your ear.
Natural Sound: Clear, lifelike sound so you can enjoy every moment.
Rechargeable: Up to 38 hours of power—no tiny batteries to change.
Waterproof: Designed to handle water up to 1 meter deep.
Custom Fit: Made just for your ears for all-day comfort and security.
Starkey Edge AI
Starkey Edge AI hearing aids use AI to improve sound clarity and reduce background noise. A powerful smart chip helps focus on speech so users can hear better in noisy places.

Edge AI adjusts automatically to different environments, making speech 30% clearer than older models. Whether you’re at a party, restaurant, or at home, these hearing aids help you understand conversations better.
Built to Last: Waterproof up to 1 meter and sweat-resistant.
Strong Bluetooth Connection: Works with smartphones and connects easily to TVs and public sound systems using Auracast™.
Health & Safety Features: Includes balance exercises and fall detection.
Easy App Control: The My Starkey app allows you to adjust settings, control volume, stream calls, and find lost hearing aids. Compatible with smartphones and Apple Watch.
Starkey Genesis AI RIC

The Starkey Genesis AI hearing aids use smart technology to help people hear soft sounds clearly, understand speech better, and reduce listening effort. The AI adapts to different situations, ensuring great sound wherever you go.

Genesis AI receiver-in-the-canal (RIC) hearing aids work for mild to severe hearing loss. They come in rechargeable or disposable battery options. The rechargeable battery lasts up to 51 hours on a full charge and can provide 3 hours of use with just a 7-minute charge.
Waterproof: Special coating protects against sweat, rain, and dirt.
Bluetooth Connectivity: The My Starkey app lets users adjust settings, stream calls, and locate lost hearing aids.
Remote Support: TeleHear allows remote adjustments via video chat.
Tinnitus Relief: Custom sound options help manage ringing in the ears.
Starkey Genesis AI ITE

Starkey’s in-the-ear (ITE) hearing aids are custom-made to fit comfortably. The Genesis AI ITE uses a smart processor that works like the human brain to provide clear and natural sound in different environments.

These hearing aids work for mild to severe hearing loss. They come in rechargeable and disposable battery options. The latest Genesis AI ITE model is the smallest wireless CIC hearing aid, offering a nearly invisible fit without reducing sound quality.
Waterproof: Special layers protect the hearing aid from water, sweat, and dust.
Bluetooth Connectivity: Connects to smartphones for easy control.
Remote Support: Adjustments can be made remotely through video chat.
Tinnitus Relief: Custom sound options help reduce ringing in the ears.
Starkey CROS

Starkey’s CROS hearing aids help people who have hearing loss in one ear. These devices pick up sound from the weaker ear and send it to the stronger ear, making it easier to hear conversations and sounds around you.
The CROS hearing aids work with the Genesis AI models and some older Starkey models.

Starkey’s Evolv AI behind-the-ear (BTE) hearing aids adjust automatically to the environment to improve hearing. They make 55 million automatic adjustments every hour and help reduce background noise, such as wind and machine sounds.

Starkey Hearing Aids

Roberts Hearing Clinic is an authorized provider of Starkey hearing aids in Alexandria, LA.

Starkey is known for creating advanced hearing aids that help people hear better in all kinds of situations. Starkey hearing aids are small, custom-fit hearing aids that are comfortable and reliable for various listening situations.

Starkey also uses artificial intelligence (AI) to improve sound quality and make listening easier. Their wide range of hearing aids fits different needs and lifestyles.

Current Starkey Hearing Aid Models

Starkey Omega AI

Starkey Omega AI is built with industry-leading technology that gives users powerful sound clarity and day-long comfort. Its advanced AI system constantly analyzes your surroundings to help you hear speech clearly, stay aware of important sounds, and move through different environments with ease.

If you struggle with hearing in noisy places, Omega AI’s Edge Mode+ provides on-demand help by sharpening speech instantly, even in challenging spaces like restaurants, shopping centers, or family gatherings.

These hearing aids are also designed for durability. With a 10x more durable waterproof coating, Omega AI can handle rain, sweat, and everyday wear without worry. Rechargeable options give all-day power, keeping you connected from morning to night.

Unique Features:

  • Edge Mode+: Boosts speech clarity during tough listening moments.
  • Waterproof & Everyday-Proof: Designed for active lifestyles and all-day comfort.
  • Auracast™ & LE Audio Ready: Allows streaming from TVs, smartphones, public announcement systems, and more.
  • Starkey App (Now Powered by Gen AI): Use TeleHear AI for instant, AI-based sound adjustments.

Starkey Signature Series

The Starkey Signature Series gives you amazing sound in hearing aids that are super tiny and almost invisible. They are custom-made to fit inside your ear, so no one can tell you’re wearing them. You’ll hear your friends, family, and the world around you clearly, without anyone knowing why. Whether you want rechargeable, adjustable, or the smallest size possible, there’s a signature style just for you.

Unique Features:

  • Discreet: Nearly invisible and fits deep in your ear.
  • Natural Sound: Clear, lifelike sound so you can enjoy every moment.
  • Rechargeable: Up to 38 hours of power—no tiny batteries to change.
  • Waterproof: Designed to handle water up to 1 meter deep.
  • Custom Fit: Made just for your ears for all-day comfort and security.

Starkey Edge AI

Starkey Edge AI hearing aids use AI to improve sound clarity and reduce background noise. A powerful smart chip helps focus on speech so users can hear better in noisy places.

Edge AI adjusts automatically to different environments, making speech 30% clearer than older models. Whether you’re at a party, restaurant, or at home, these hearing aids help you understand conversations better.

Unique Features:

  • Built to Last: Waterproof up to 1 meter and sweat-resistant.
  • Strong Bluetooth Connection: Works with smartphones and connects easily to TVs and public sound systems using Auracast™.
  • Health & Safety Features: Includes balance exercises and fall detection.
  • Easy App Control: The My Starkey app allows you to adjust settings, control volume, stream calls, and find lost hearing aids. Compatible with smartphones and Apple Watch.

Starkey Genesis AI RIC

The Starkey Genesis AI hearing aids use smart technology to help people hear soft sounds clearly, understand speech better, and reduce listening effort. The AI adapts to different situations, ensuring great sound wherever you go.

Genesis AI receiver-in-the-canal (RIC) hearing aids work for mild to severe hearing loss. They come in rechargeable or disposable battery options. The rechargeable battery lasts up to 51 hours on a full charge and can provide 3 hours of use with just a 7-minute charge.

Unique Features:

  • Waterproof: Special coating protects against sweat, rain, and dirt.
  • Bluetooth Connectivity: The My Starkey app lets users adjust settings, stream calls, and locate lost hearing aids.
  • Remote Support: TeleHear allows remote adjustments via video chat.
  • Tinnitus Relief: Custom sound options help manage ringing in the ears.

Starkey Genesis AI ITE

Starkey’s in-the-ear (ITE) hearing aids are custom-made to fit comfortably. The Genesis AI ITE uses a smart processor that works like the human brain to provide clear and natural sound in different environments.

These hearing aids work for mild to severe hearing loss. They come in rechargeable and disposable battery options. The latest Genesis AI ITE model is the smallest wireless CIC hearing aid, offering a nearly invisible fit without reducing sound quality.

Unique Features:

  • Waterproof: Special layers protect the hearing aid from water, sweat, and dust.
  • Bluetooth Connectivity: Connects to smartphones for easy control.
  • Remote Support: Adjustments can be made remotely through video chat.
  • Tinnitus Relief: Custom sound options help reduce ringing in the ears.

Starkey CROS

Starkey’s CROS hearing aids help people who have hearing loss in one ear. These devices pick up sound from the weaker ear and send it to the stronger ear, making it easier to hear conversations and sounds around you.

The CROS hearing aids work with the Genesis AI models and some older Starkey models.

Starkey Evolv AI BTE

Starkey’s Evolv AI behind-the-ear (BTE) hearing aids adjust automatically to the environment to improve hearing. They make 55 million automatic adjustments every hour and help reduce background noise, such as wind and machine sounds.

Evolv AI BTE hearing aids work for mild to severe hearing loss. They come with rechargeable or disposable battery options.

Unique Features:

  • Bluetooth Connectivity: Works with the Thrive Hearing Control app for easy adjustments.
  • Remote Support: Adjustments can be made through video chat.
  • Tinnitus Relief: Custom sound programs help reduce ringing in the ears.

Starkey Evolv AI Power Plus BTE

The Starkey Evolv AI Power Plus BTE has the same features as the Evolv AI BTE but provides more power for people with severe to profound hearing loss.

These hearing aids use a size 13 disposable battery.

Unique Features:

  • Bluetooth Connectivity: Connects with the Thrive Hearing Control app for easy settings.
  • Remote Support: Adjustments can be made remotely.
  • Tinnitus Relief: Custom sound settings to help reduce ringing in the ears.

  • Remote Mic +

What are the tech levels of Starkey Genesis AI?

There are four technology levels: 24 (highest), 20, 16, and 12 (lowest). A CROS model is also available for people with severe hearing loss in one ear.

What app does Starkey Genesis AI use?

The My Starkey app connects with Genesis AI hearing aids. It lets users adjust settings, track their well-being, and find lost hearing aids.

How long do Starkey hearing aids last?

In-the-ear hearing aids usually last about five years, while behind-the-ear hearing aids last five to six years. How well you take care of them can affect their lifespan. Tinnitus Support
Roberts Hearing Clinic provides expert tinnitus support in Alexandria, LA.

Tinnitus is a condition where you hear ringing, buzzing, hissing, or clicking sounds in your ears when there is no actual noise around you. It can be mild and occasional or persistent and disruptive, making it harder to focus, sleep, or enjoy daily activities.
What Causes Tinnitus?
Tinnitus can develop due to various factors, including:
Hearing loss – When the brain doesn’t receive normal sound input, it may create its own noises.
Exposure to loud sounds – Loud music, machinery, or concerts can damage hearing over time.
Earwax buildup – Too much earwax can block the ear canal and cause ringing.
Medications – Some drugs have tinnitus as a side effect.
Health conditions – Issues like high blood pressure, ear infections, and TMJ disorders can contribute to tinnitus.
Tinnitus Care Options
While there is no permanent cure for tinnitus, many treatments can help reduce symptoms and make it easier to live with.
Sound Therapy
Background noise can help mask tinnitus and make it less noticeable. Common options include:
White noise machines
Fans or soothing background music
Hearing aids with built-in sound masking
Hearing Aids
Lifestyle Changes
Everyday choices can also affect tinnitus. Certain habits may make symptoms worse, so it may help to:
Limit caffeine and alcohol
Use ear protection in noisy places
Practice relaxation exercises to reduce stress
Maintain a regular sleep routine
When to Seek More Care

While hearing aids and healthy lifestyle changes can be very effective, some people may need additional treatment. If symptoms persist or worsen, we may refer you to an ENT specialist for more comprehensive care.
Frequently Asked Questions About Tinnitus
Will tinnitus go away on its own?
Tinnitus may fade over time, especially if caused by a temporary issue like noise exposure or earwax buildup. However, if it lasts for weeks or worsens, seeing an audiologist is recommended.
Can stress make tinnitus worse?

Yes, stress and anxiety can increase tinnitus awareness. When your brain is stressed, it can become more sensitive to sounds, including internal ringing. Managing stress through relaxation techniques may help reduce symptoms.
Is tinnitus always linked to hearing loss?
Not always. While many people with tinnitus also have hearing loss, some with normal hearing still experience it. A hearing test can determine if hearing loss is a contributing factor.
Do hearing aids help with tinnitus?

Yes! Hearing aids can amplify external sounds, reducing the contrast between environmental sounds and tinnitus. Many also come with built-in tinnitus masking features that play soothing sounds to help distract from the ringing.
Can ear wax cause tinnitus?
Yes, excess earwax can block sound and cause ringing or buzzing in the ears. If earwax buildup is the cause, professional earwax removal can provide relief.
Tinnitus Support in Alexandria, LA
Our audiologist in Alexandria, LA, is here to help with expert tinnitus support and treatment options to make the ringing in your ears more manageable.
Call us today to schedule your tinnitus management!

Unitron Hearing Aids
Roberts Hearing Clinic is an authorized provider of Unitron hearing aids in Alexandria, LA.

Unitron is a Canadian company that has been making hearing aids for over 50 years. Their smart technology automatically adjusts to different environments, whether you are at home, in a crowded restaurant, or outdoors.
Unitron hearing aids are designed to help people hear more clearly in different situations. They offer clear sound, easy-to-use features, and a comfortable fit.
Current Unitron Hearing Aid Models
Unitron Moxi S-R

The Unitron Moxi S-R is a small, stylish hearing aid that’s made to fit comfortably and work reliably every day. It’s powered by Unitron’s newest Smile platform, which helps you hear clearly in more places and enjoy life’s sounds with ease.

Moxi S-R is also built to handle water and moisture, so you don’t have to worry about splashes or weather. With its easy-to-use charger and a portable ChargerGo, you can keep your hearing aids powered, whether you’re at home or on the move.
Unique Perks and Features:
Water-Resistant: Special coating helps protect from moisture.
Easy Charging: Simple charging at home or on-the-go with ChargerGo.
All-Day Power: Keeps up with your busy life without running out of charge.
Unitron Ativo

Unitron Ativo hearing aids give you clear sound and wireless connection at a price that’s easy to love. You can take hands-free phone calls, stream music or videos, and enjoy great hearing – all in a design that’s both comfortable and stylish. Ativo helps you stay connected to your favorite people, sounds, and moments every day.
Bluetooth Connectivity: Take calls and stream sound straight from your phone.
Clear Sound: Enjoy Unitron’s reliable sound performance in any setting.
Hands-Free Calling: Talk on the phone without holding it up.
Stylish and Comfortable: Designed to look good and feel good all day.
Affordable Quality: Great technology at an easy-to-access price.
Unitron Insera S-R

Powered by the advanced Smile platform, the Insera S-R is meticulously crafted to fit the unique contours of your ear, offering a discreet design without compromising on power. Whether you’re in a crowded restaurant or a quiet home, its AI-driven technology automatically adjusts to your environment, making hearing feel natural and effortless.
It comes with robust Bluetooth connectivity and all-day battery life to help you stay connected to the people and devices that matter most.
EarMatch™ Customization: An evolved design process that uses deep-fit modeling and intentional microphone placement to optimize sound performance specifically for your unique ear anatomy.

Universal Bluetooth® Connectivity: Enjoy stable, hands-free calls and high-quality media streaming. The Insera S-R features up to 6x more wireless transmission power and double the connection range of previous models.
Rechargeable Custom Fit: Combines the “invisible” appeal of a custom-molded hearing aid with the modern convenience of lithium-ion reliability and a magnetic “snap-and-charge” docking station.

HyperFocus & Speech Enhancement: Advanced spatial features that zoom in on speech during loud conversations while reducing the listening effort required in quieter settings to prevent “listening fatigue.”
IP68-Rated Durability: Engineered for everyday life with proven wax protection and a rugged, water-resistant design that ensures dependable performance in all conditions.
Unitron Moxi V-RS
The Unitron Moxi V-RS is a small, lightweight hearing aid that sits behind the ear. It blends in naturally and provides clear sound in both quiet and noisy environments.
Bluetooth Connection: Pairs with phones, TVs, and tablets for direct audio streaming.
Rechargeable Batteries: Charges overnight so there is no need to change small batteries.
App Support: The Remote Plus App allows you to adjust settings and volume. Hearing care providers can also fine-tune them remotely.
Unitron Moxi Vivante (V)
The Moxi Vivante is designed to make speech clearer, even in noisy settings. It is suitable for mild to severe hearing loss.
Bluetooth: Connects to phones, televisions, and other devices.
App Support: The Remote Plus App provides control over volume and settings.
Tinnitus Relief: Includes features that play soft background sounds to help ease ringing in the ears.
Rechargeable Battery: Provides a full day of use with a single charge.
Unitron Stride Blu (B)
The Stride Blu is a behind-the-ear hearing aid that offers clear sound for mild to severe hearing loss.
Bluetooth: Streams audio from phones, TVs, and computers.
App Support: The Remote Plus App allows for easy sound adjustments.
Tinnitus Relief: Provides calming background sounds to reduce ringing in the ears.
Rechargeable Battery: Delivers long-lasting power without the need for disposable batteries.
Unitron Stride Blu (B) UP
The Stride B UP is designed for individuals with severe to profound hearing loss. It provides strong, clear sound and is worn behind the ear.
Bluetooth: Pairs with phones, televisions, and other devices.
App Support: Users can adjust settings through the Remote Plus App.
Tinnitus Relief: Offers sound therapy to help manage ringing in the ears.
Disposable Batteries: Uses size 675 batteries for extended power.
Unitron Insera Blu (B)
The Insera Blu is a custom-made hearing aid that fits securely inside the ear. It is available in multiple styles to meet different hearing needs:
In-the-Canal (ITC)
Completely-in-the-Canal (CIC)
Invisible-in-the-Canal (IIC)
Bluetooth: Connects to phones, TVs, and computers for direct audio streaming.
App Support: Users can control settings through the Remote Plus App.
Tinnitus Relief: Includes soft background sounds that help reduce ringing in the ears.
Older Unitron Hearing Aid Models Supported by Roberts Hearing Clinic
Roberts Hearing Clinic may still provide servicing and repairs for older Unitron hearing aid models.
Older models that may be supported include:
Unitron Moxi B-R
Unitron Moxi B-RT
Unitron Moxi B-312
Unitron Moxi Fit
Unitron Moxi Move R
Unitron Moxi Jump R T
Unitron Insera W 312
Unitron Insera 312 Omni
Unitron Insera 10 Omni
Unitron Insera
Unitron Stride P
Unitron Stride P R
Unitron Max SP
Unitron Max UP
Please contact us for more information.
Frequently Asked Questions About Unitron Hearing Aids
What is the difference between Unitron Blu and Vivante?

Unitron Vivante (V) replaces Unitron Blu (B) for receiver-in-the-canal (RIC) hearing aids. The Vivante models include an updated design, improved sound processing, and a more advanced Remote Plus App. For custom in-the-ear (ITE) hearing aids, the Blu series remains the latest option.

Walmart Hearing Aids: What You Need to Know Before You Buy

Hearing loss can make it harder to enjoy conversations, follow your favorite shows, and stay connected with the world around you. So, it’s understandable to want a fast and affordable fix, especially when big-box stores like Walmart now offer over-the-counter (OTC) hearing aids. But before you purchase a hearing device off the shelf, it’s important to understand what you’re really getting.

Walmart sells a range of hearing aids and personal sound amplifiers, both online and in select stores. While these may help some people with very mild hearing difficulties, they are often not the best long-term solution for personalized hearing care.

At Roberts Hearing Clinic , our licensed audiologists take the time to understand your unique hearing needs, lifestyle, and budget. We guide you through every step of the process, starting with a comprehensive hearing evaluation.
Before you buy from Walmart, here’s what you should know.
Are Walmart Hearing Aids the Real Deal?
Many people don’t realize there’s a difference between real hearing aids and personal sound amplifiers (PSAPs). Walmart carries both, but not all are true hearing aids.
Real Hearing Aids vs. Amplifiers: What’s the Difference?

FDA-Registered Hearing Aids – These are actual medical devices designed to help with mild to moderate hearing loss. Some OTC models fall into this category and can be purchased without a prescription.

Sound Amplifiers (PSAPs) – These only make sounds louder. They are not designed to treat hearing loss and do not adjust based on your hearing needs. They are also not regulated the same way as hearing aids.
How to Spot the Difference:
Look for FDA registration
Read the packaging-does it say “hearing aid” or “amplifier”?
Price can be a clue-devices under $200 are often amplifiers
Check if the device offers fitting or programming options
If you’re in doubt with the quality or effectiveness of Walmart hearing aids, seek an audiologist’s expertise.
Roberts Hearing Clinic offers a wide selection of hearing aids in Alexandria, LA. Our licensed audiologists can help you choose the best hearing device for your unique hearing needs.
Walmart’s Most Popular Hearing Aids
Some of Walmart’s top-selling hearing devices include:
HearingAssist Rechargeable OTC Hearing Aids Rechargeable and labeled as FDA-registered, but lack any custom fitting or professional follow-up.
Go Hearing Go Lite & Go Prime Inexpensive and discreet, but offer minimal sound control and struggle in noisy environments.
Lucid Hearing Engage One of the more advanced OTC models, with app control features-but setup can be tricky without help.
MDHearingAid AIR and VOLT Sold online as “medical-grade,” but don’t include the in-person fitting and care that lead to long-term success.
These options may work for some individuals with very mild hearing loss, but they often fall short when it comes to clarity, comfort, and reliable support.
At Roberts Hearing Clinic, we provide customized hearing solutions that include professional guidance and local support, so you get the most out of your investment.
Limitations of Walmart Hearing Aids
Purchasing OTC hearing aids from Walmart may be helpful for some but they have their limits which include:
No hearing evaluation
One-size-fits-all design
No custom programming
Limited features and no ongoing care
At Roberts Hearing Clinic, we go beyond the basics. Our services include:
Comprehensive hearing evaluations
Hearing aid fitting and programming
Follow-up visits and cleanings
Repairs and troubleshooting
Ongoing education and support
When you work with an audiologist, you don’t just get a device, you get a partner in your hearing health .
Do Cheap Hearing Aids Work?
Sometimes. But from an audiologist’s perspective, low-cost hearing devices often lack the features and support that make real improvements in daily life especially in busy or noisy environments.
Common complaints about low-cost devices:
Too loud in quiet rooms
Not clear in noisy places
Whistling or feedback
Poor fit and comfort
No support when problems arise
You don’t need to spend a fortune, but you do need the right device and the right support team.
Our audiologists at Roberts Hearing Clinic help you find an affordable solution that actually works for your hearing.
Do More Expensive Hearing Aids Work Better?
Often, yes, and not just because of the technology. Higher-quality hearing aids typically include:
Advanced noise reduction
Bluetooth and streaming features
Tinnitus relief options
Rechargeable batteries
Customizable settings for different environments
But the real value lies in the service that comes with them. When you buy from Roberts Hearing Clinic, you get:
A professional hearing test
A personalized fitting
Ongoing follow-up care
Warranty and repair support
Friendly service from audiologists who know you
That’s something you won’t get from a shelf at Walmart.
Ready for Better Hearing? We’re Here to Help.
Skip the guesswork. At Roberts Hearing Clinic, our licensed audiologists in Alexandria, LA are here to help you find the right solution for your hearing, your lifestyle, and your budget.
Call today to schedule your hearing evaluation and start hearing life more clearly.

children.text: Home » Widex Hearing Aids
Widex Hearing Aids
Roberts Hearing Clinic is an authorized provider of Widex hearing aids in Alexandria, LA.

Widex is one of the top brands bringing artificial intelligence (AI) to hearing aids. Widex hearing aids offer excellent performance, combining human and AI technology. Over the years, they have created hearing aids that provide clear and natural sound.
Widex hearing aids also help people with tinnitus (ringing in the ears) to reduce discomfort.
Current Widex Hearing Aid Models
Widex Allure

The Widex Allure carries the brand’s most advanced hearing aid platform, offering the perfect blend of cutting-edge technology and elegant design. It is crafted to deliver the most natural hearing experience possible, helping you reconnect with the world through clear speech, accurate environmental sound processing, and intuitive adjustments.
Unique Perks and Features:
Powered by the W1 Chip: Widex’s fastest chip delivers quick, clear, and natural sound.
Allure PureSound™ with ZeroDelay Technology: Helps you hear speech without distortion or echo, creating a more lifelike experience.
Speech Enhancer Pro: Lowers background noise so voices stand out, making conversations easier—even in noisy places.
Dynamic Feedback Controller: Adapts to your ear’s shape to reduce annoying whistling or squealing sounds.
Smooth Streaming: Enjoy music, podcasts, and calls with steady sound—no sudden volume changes or outside interference.
Widex Allure App: Easily adjust settings and personalize your hearing experience right from your smartphone.
Widex SmartRIC

Widex SmartRIC is designed to help you hear better in noisy places. Its unique L-shape design sits higher on the ear, making voices clearer. The battery lasts up to 37 hours, so you can use it all day without worry.

The charger is small and portable, giving you a week’s worth of power so you can stay connected anywhere. The SmartRIC also has an advanced microphone cover that helps reduce background noise, so you hear more clearly.
Key Features:
App: Works with the Moment app, allowing you to adjust settings to fit your needs.
Bluetooth: Connects to both iPhone and Android devices for easy streaming.
Tinnitus Relief: Uses special Zen sounds to help manage ringing in the ears.
Widex Moment Sheer RIC

The Widex Moment Sheer RIC (receiver-in-the-canal) hearing aid has a sleek new design and an improved charger. It allows you to personalize your hearing through the Moment app. The dual AI technology helps you get the best sound possible.

This hearing aid is great for people with mild to severe hearing loss. It comes in both rechargeable and disposable battery options. The battery lasts about 29 hours without streaming or 16 hours with 8 hours of streaming.
Bluetooth: Connects to both iPhone and Android devices.
App: Lets you adjust settings for a perfect fit.
Tinnitus Relief: Zen programs provide relaxing sounds to help with tinnitus.
Widex Moment RIC

The Widex Moment RIC hearing aid is small and gives a natural sound experience. It processes sound faster, making speech clearer, even in noisy places. Studies show that 91% of users are happy with the sound quality, and many prefer it over their old hearing aids.
This model works for mild to severe hearing loss and comes with either a rechargeable or disposable battery option.
Bluetooth: Connects to iPhones and Androids for streaming.
App: Customize your hearing settings for a better experience.
Tinnitus Relief: Zen programs offer special sounds to help with tinnitus.
Widex Moment BTE
Widex Moment BTE (behind-the-ear) uses AI to learn what sounds you like. The SoundSense Learn feature adjusts settings automatically based on what you need at the moment.
This hearing aid fits mild to severe hearing loss and comes with a rechargeable or size 13 disposable battery.
Bluetooth: Works with iPhones and Androids.
App: Adjust settings easily based on your needs.
Tinnitus Relief: Zen sounds help reduce ringing in the ears.
Widex Moment CROS

Widex leads the way in CROS technology, which helps people who can hear in only one ear. The Widex CROS sends sound from the ear that cannot hear to the ear that can. This makes it easier to hear where sounds are coming from and improves listening in noisy places.
It can be used as a CROS (for hearing loss in one ear) or a BiCROS (for hearing loss in both ears but worse in one). The Widex CROS uses less power than other CROS devices, making it more efficient.
Widex Moment ITE
Widex Moment ITE (in-the-ear) hearing aids are custom-made to fit your ear perfectly. They automatically adjust to give clear and natural sound.
Widex Moment ITE is great for mild to moderate hearing loss. It comes with size 10 or 312 disposable batteries, lasting between 105 and 150 hours, depending on use.
Custom Fit: Made to fit your ear shape perfectly.
Connectivity: Works with Bluetooth and remote control apps.
Tinnitus Relief: Zen programs help reduce tinnitus symptoms.
Widex Assistive Listening Devices
Widex TV Play: Streams TV sound directly to your hearing aids for clear sound.
Widex Sound Assist: Works as a microphone, hands-free device, and remote control.
Com-Dex, RC-Dex, TV-Dex: Additional accessories for better hearing control.
Older Widex Hearing Aids Supported by Roberts Hearing Clinic
If you have an older Widex hearing aid, we may still be able to service or repair it.
Widex Evoke
Widex Beyond
Widex Unique
Widex Dream
Please contact us for more details.
Frequently Asked Questions
What is the best Widex hearing aid?
The Widex Moment Sheer 440 is the top model. It has the best sound features, including wind noise reduction and speech enhancement.
What are the levels of Widex Moment?
There are three levels of Widex Moment hearing aids:
Widex Moment 220: Basic Level
Widex Moment 330: Standard Level
Widex Moment 440: Premium Level
Is Widex Moment good for tinnitus?
Yes! Widex Moment hearing aids come with Zen programs to help with tinnitus. These programs use relaxing sounds to make tinnitus less noticeable.
Find the Right Widex Hearing Aid for You
At Roberts Hearing Clinic , we help you choose the best Widex hearing aid for your needs. We are an authorized provider of Widex hearing aids in Alexandria, LA.
Contact us today to learn more!
Current Widex Hearing Aid Models
Widex Allure
Widex SmartRIC
Widex Moment Sheer RIC
Widex Moment RIC
Widex Moment BTE
Widex Moment CROS

It can be used as a CROS (for hearing loss in one ear) or a BiCROS (for hearing loss in both ears but worse in one). The Widex CROS uses less power than other CROS devices, making it more efficient.

Widex Moment ITE

Widex Moment ITE (in-the-ear) hearing aids are custom-made to fit your ear perfectly. They automatically adjust to give clear and natural sound.

Widex Moment ITE is great for mild to moderate hearing loss. It comes with size 10 or 312 disposable batteries, lasting between 105 and 150 hours, depending on use.

Key Features:

  • Custom Fit: Made to fit your ear shape perfectly.
  • Connectivity: Works with Bluetooth and remote control apps.
  • Tinnitus Relief: Zen programs help reduce tinnitus symptoms.

Widex Assistive Listening Devices

  • Widex TV Play: Streams TV sound directly to your hearing aids for clear sound.
  • Widex Sound Assist: Works as a microphone, hands-free device, and remote control.
  • Com-Dex, RC-Dex, TV-Dex: Additional accessories for better hearing control.

Frequently Asked Questions

What is the best Widex hearing aid?

The Widex Moment Sheer 440 is the top model. It has the best sound features, including wind noise reduction and speech enhancement.

What are the levels of Widex Moment?

There are three levels of Widex Moment hearing aids:

  • Widex Moment 220: Basic Level
  • Widex Moment 330: Standard Level
  • Widex Moment 440: Premium Level

Is Widex Moment good for tinnitus?

Yes! Widex Moment hearing aids come with Zen programs to help with tinnitus. These programs use relaxing sounds to make tinnitus less noticeable.
